description: The final format of a game: its released repo and its dataset. Prose: docs/game-format.md. Validator: tools/validate-game.py (repo + dataset contents) with tools/validate-dataset.ps1 (dataset layout). Severity: error = not in the format; warning = a quality rule or something to look at.

repo.what: the game's git repo at its release commit (tracked files only)

required_files.what: the project; EngineAssociation names the engine
every editor script that was run, kept unchanged
the creation record; every row matches docs/schemas/workflow-row.schema.json
hero image + captioned gallery of real gameplay stills
every external asset; matches docs/schemas/assets-manifest.schema.json, every listed file committed
Git LFS for every binary type
build output and the local dataset zip
creation replay config (ReplayScripts/ of the dataset)

banned_names.what: never inside a game: tool, vendor and owner names (text files of the repo; LFS and binary files are scanned by tools/package-game.ps1 -Rescan)

account_name.what: the account (user) name of the machine running the validator, as a word (USERNAME at run time; machine paths carry it): never written in the repo
account_name.why: user decision (b), 2026-10-15: enforced in workflow.jsonl, ReplayConfig.json and every other non-script file; scripts (Scripts/, and .ps1/.psm1/.py/.sh/.bat/.cmd files anywhere) that already ran stay unchanged and are scrubbed at packaging

repo.dataset_folder: Dataset/ (variant repo-dataset): checked as a dataset when manifest.json is there; a game that is not packaged yet has none
tasks: Tasks/<game>-<kind>-<slug>.json, one GameTask each (game-task/1), on the repo's orphan branch `tasks` (no shared history with main; a short README.md, optionally tasks-workflow.jsonl), never on main; the name field equals the file stem

the tasks branch is checked out as a git worktree outside the game folder (e.g. <root>/tasks/<slug>) and committed and pushed there; task work never enters the game's history: main tracks nothing under Tasks/ and never references the tasks branch, the recording and live-replay hooks ignore commits on it, and the delivered history (History/) leaves it out
the validator and the packager read the tasks from `tasks`, else `origin/tasks`; a missing tasks branch is an error
at least one task (none is an error); about 10 recommended (the count is reported, never an error or warning)
seed.game is the repo's slug; seed.commit and seed.reference are commits of main's history (ancestors of main's head)

An agent given a task starts from a history-less snapshot of the game at seed.commit with Tasks/, History/ and Dataset/ removed (they hold every task's rubrics and references): only the brief and that snapshot. The grader's half (milestones: rubrics, judge and code-judge questions, log_absent patterns; and seed.reference) never reaches the agent.

dataset.layout: docs/dataset-layout-v1.3.json for new deliveries (v1.2 and v1.1 stay valid for deliveries made before); tools/validate-dataset.ps1 picks the file by manifest.layout
manifest: game equals the zip's top folder (full variant)
every files[] entry exists with that size (sha256 checked by validate-dataset.ps1)
totals.files = number of files[]; totals.bytes = sum of their bytes
status complete: pending empty, replay_verification.pass true, report.json verdict.pass true
variant full: build is an object; repo-dataset: build is null
commit equals the last commit in git.log and report.json final_commit
workflow: every line is one JSON object matching the row schema
a row's direction names an earlier op user.direction row
user.direction rows: actor user, reason_source user_direction, params.direction a non-empty string
v1.2: the person's directions are user.direction rows (they replace conversation transcripts); a game with none is reported as a warning

banned names in rows: workflow.jsonl is append-only except that a row naming a banned term (or the old schema id superposition.ue-workflow/v0) is edited in place to a neutral word or placeholder, nothing else changed, followed by one appended row op "log.correct", params {rows: [ids], what}; the commit names the edited rows (tools/scrub-workflow-rows.py). A banned name left in a row is an error, in the repo and in the dataset.
history: v1.2 full variant: manifest.history is an object; History/<game>.bundle is a git bundle whose refs include history.head = manifest.commit
the bundle holds every commit (history.commits); git.log lists the same commits
every Git LFS pointer in every commit has its object under History/lfs/objects/<aa>/<bb>/<sha256>, and each object's sha256 equals its name (history.lfs_objects / lfs_bytes count them)
author and committer of every commit are dev_NN; commit messages and text blobs carry no banned names (same scan as the repo)
brief: v1.2: Brief/brief.md (the original brief) and Brief/design.md (design doc, story bible, status) are present and non-empty; manifest.brief names them
tasks: v1.3 full variant: Tasks/README.md and, per task, Tasks/<name>/task.json (the agent's part) and Tasks/<name>/grader.json (milestones, seed.reference); manifest.tasks lists the names
task.json holds no milestones and no seed.reference; task.json merged with grader.json is valid against docs/schemas/game-task.schema.json
each task's name equals its folder; seed.game is the dataset's game; seed.commit and seed.reference are commits of History/<game>.bundle
at least one task; about 10 recommended
repo-dataset: no Tasks/ (the repo's tasks branch is the source)

An agent given a task starts from a history-less snapshot of the game at seed.commit with Tasks/, History/ and Dataset/ removed (they hold every task's rubrics and references): only the brief and that snapshot. The grader's half (milestones: rubrics, judge and code-judge questions, log_absent patterns; and seed.reference) never reaches the agent.
